asset.name: StreamingText
asset.description: The incremental text renderer batching updates to a stable cadence, avoiding excessive reflow, preserving user selection, handling partial markup boundaries, and supporting interruption mid-stream.

requires.reason: Copy uses the shared text styles rather than local typography.
Announcements go through the one shared live region so nothing talks over anything else.

signatureMoment.description: Text arrives at a readable, even pace rather than in visible bursts, and selecting part of it mid-stream keeps the selection intact as more arrives.

rationale: Two failures define this asset. Announcing every token makes a screen reader unusable, so announcement is bound to settled boundaries rather than to each update. And re-rendering per token at speed destroys both selection and frame rate, so updates are batched to a cadence rather than driven by arrival.
